# Dynatrace Javascript Runtime

This package provides the Dynatrace JavaScript runtime used by
the [Dynatrace App Toolkit](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dt-app).

## Usage

This package should not be used directly, use the [Dynatrace App Toolkit](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dt-app) instead.
